qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Pre-commercial clinical biotech). Zero product revenue; enterprise value hinges entirely on binary clinical and regulatory trial outcomes for single lead drug candidate obefazimod in ulcerative colitis.
qualitative.evidence: Pre-revenue clinical-stage biotechnology company with net losses expanding from €182M in 2024 to €336M in 2025 as Phase 3 trials progress. Generates no commercial product sales, lacking an established economic engine or multi-cycle operating track record.
